specifications.Latest negative review: Connor Glass 03 Oct, 2026 | 07:10 2.0 Paid for two servers, still waiting on one and clear answers We paid InterServer $709 for two dedicated servers on September 24, 2026. One was delivered on October 2. As of October 2, the other still shows "Setu...p In-progress," with no firm delivery date. We followed up repeatedly and requested a supervisor, a firm handoff date, and a billing credit on September 29. That escalation on the remaining server's ticket is still unanswered. Support had answered a configuration question earlier, but did not explain the delay or provide an ETA. We specifically passed on overseas hardware options because we wanted to work with an American tech company and expected U.S.-based technical support. When we called for service, we reached a call center in India. That was disappointing, especially while we were already struggling to get answers about our order. This has disrupted our migration planning and made it difficult to trust the onboarding process. Delays can happen, but getting a clear answer should not require repeated chasing. faqs.question: Is InterServer's $2.50/month price permanent or does it increase at renewal?
faqs.answer: InterServer’s price-lock guarantee means you pay the same rate at renewal that you paid when you signed up. There is no promotional period that expires. faqs.question: Does either provider include daily automated backups at no extra cost?
faqs.answer: Neither provider includes daily automated backups on entry shared plans at no charge. InterServer includes weekly backups by default. Bluehost includes weekly backups on standard plans and daily backups on eCommerce plans. Bluehost’s CodeGuard advanced backup add-on costs $2.99/month for more granular control.
